what: The live-review wake poster's GitHub-runner path fails to commit packets with HTTP 403. MEASURED 2026-11-20, twice: run 44754456840 (14:33Z, 7 SLV paper packages) and run 44812226372 (20:33Z, XRP real-money package): packet_state could_not_commit, packet_reason 'git data API commit failed', evidence_http_code 403. In both cases the VM poster (poster 'vm') posted the same events minutes earlier with packets committed fine, so no review was lost. But the runner path re-posts duplicate wakes that cannot be reviewed (runbook: could_not_commit means no reviewer), which adds noise and could hide a real gap if the VM poster ever stops. TO CHECK: the token/permission the runner path uses for the git data API on live-review/rows (contents:write?), whether a secondary rate limit is hit, and whether the runner poster should skip events the VM already committed. It must add no new gate.
